derivation: Both endpoints are measured against the TARGET test tree, since tests/test.sh restores every sympy/**/tests/ subtree from the target revision. required_to_pass is the nodes that fail or are absent with base-revision source under that tree and pass with target-revision source, scoped to the expression core, the elementary and special functions, the series machinery, the matrices, the number-theory module, the parsers and the printers. must_keep_passing is exactly the nodes that pass at the no-op. excluded holds pre-existing failures, skips, the optional-dependency printer module that needs torch, 66 nodes that are COLLECTION COLLATERAL, the whole of printing/tests/test_mathml.py, and 8 nodes that no in-scope source change can reach. The collateral was separated by measurement with a probe tree that restores collection using five non-functional stubs: nodes passing under the probe never needed the release and are excluded, nodes still failing are required. test_mathml.py is excluded as a SCOPE decision, not a defect: the release reworks the MathML printer so heavily that its 55 nodes alone would be 47.4 percent of the required set, making one objective worth half the score and destroying the breadth this bundle exists to measure. The 8 unreachable nodes need edits in codegen, physics, tensor and polys, outside the declared scope; requiring them would make the deterministic channel demand work the judged scope criterion forbids. All three sets are mutually disjoint.
